# Rakuten
> Rakuten is a cash back and coupons platform that helps shoppers earn rewards at thousands of online stores.

Rakuten lets members shop through partner merchant pages, activate Cash Back offers, apply promo codes, and receive payments by check or PayPal. The site also provides browser extension support, referral programs, gift card offers, and category-based shopping discovery across fashion, beauty, travel, electronics, and home.

## Core Pages
- [Rakuten Homepage](https://www.rakuten.com): Main entry point for browsing Cash Back offers, coupons, featured stores, and promotions.
- [How Rakuten Works](https://www.rakuten.com/how-it-works.htm): Overview of earning Cash Back, shopping through Rakuten, and getting paid.
- [Join Rakuten](https://www.rakuten.com/r/JOINNOW): Sign-up flow for creating a new Rakuten member account.
- [Refer a Friend](https://www.rakuten.com/referral/default.do): Referral program details for inviting friends and earning bonuses.
- [Stores](https://www.rakuten.com/stores/all.htm): Directory of participating stores and brands available on Rakuten.
- [Coupons](https://www.rakuten.com/coupons): Central page for browsing coupon codes and current savings offers.
- [Double Cash Back Stores](https://www.rakuten.com/doublecashback.htm): Featured merchants currently offering elevated Cash Back rates.

## Shopping Categories
- [Clothing](https://www.rakuten.com/clothing.htm): Apparel and fashion retailers with Cash Back rates and coupon offers.
- [Shoes](https://www.rakuten.com/shoes.htm): Shoe and footwear stores with available discounts and Cash Back.
- [Beauty & Fragrance](https://www.rakuten.com/beauty.htm): Beauty, skincare, makeup, and fragrance merchants on Rakuten.
- [Electronics](https://www.rakuten.com/electronics.htm): Electronics and tech retailers with Cash Back and promo codes.
- [Home & Garden](https://www.rakuten.com/home-and-garden.htm): Home goods, furniture, décor, and garden shopping offers.
- [Travel & Vacations](https://www.rakuten.com/travel-vacations.htm): Travel booking partners for hotels, flights, and vacation deals.
- [Health & Wellness](https://www.rakuten.com/health-and-beauty.htm): Health, personal care, and wellness shopping offers.
- [Pets](https://www.rakuten.com/pets.htm): Pet supply and pet care merchants with Cash Back.

- [Nike](https://www.rakuten.com/shop/nike.com): Nike shopping page with current rewards and promotional offers.

## Browser Extension & Apps
- [Rakuten Browser Extension](https://www.rakuten.com/button.htm): Information about the browser extension for automatic coupon and Cash Back activation.
- [Download on the App Store](https://www.rakuten.com/mobile.htm): Mobile app page with links for iPhone and iPad users.
- [Get It on Google Play](https://www.rakuten.com/mobile.htm): Mobile app page with Android app access and feature overview.
- [Mobile App](https://www.rakuten.com/mobile.htm): Overview of shopping, tracking, and earning Cash Back on mobile devices.

## Member Support
- [Help Center](https://www.rakuten.com/help): Support hub for account, payment, shopping, and technical questions.
- [Contact Us](https://www.rakuten.com/help/contact): Contact options for reaching Rakuten customer support.
- [Missing Cash Back](https://www.rakuten.com/help/missing-cash-back): Help page for reporting purchases that did not track correctly.
- [Payments](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/getting-paid-360002117348): Support article explaining how and when Rakuten payments are sent.
- [Account Settings Help](https://www.rakuten.com/help/category/account): Help content for profile, login, and account management issues.
- [Shopping Trips Help](https://www.rakuten.com/help/category/shopping-trips): Support articles about tracked shopping trips and order eligibility.

- [Cookie Policy](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/cookie-policy-360002117667): Information about cookies and tracking technologies used on Rakuten.
- [Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/do-not-sell-or-share-my-personal-information-360002117707): Privacy choices for applicable U.S. residents.
- [Accessibility](https://www.rakuten.com/help/article/accessibility-statement-360002117727): Accessibility statement and support information for site users.
